items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I thought you said somebody called Davis did these lyrics. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. But they claimed they got complaints about...

ctx.x: And of course, at that time... To go on with my story... I had asked Walter to do the lyric on "Lover Man" because it... "I go to bed with a prayer" and all that; you know, in those days it was a no-no. "You'll make love to me" -- it was very earthy in those days.
I thought you said somebody called Davis did these lyrics.
Yeah. But they claimed they got complaints about...
